weeks.title: Halloween wipe, the Dark Side, and a rocket called Kamikaze
weeks.headline: Fresh Halloween wipe on Oct 22, a new name for our raid server, and a vehicle shop with almost everything in it.

sections.name: New
items: Halloween wipe (Oct 22)
Same map, fresh start. Halloween runs through Oct 31: earn Ectoplasm with /ecto.
The Dark Side
Our raid server has a new name, banner and icon. Rusty Pranks is retired.
Chat across both servers
Global chat now reaches both Misfits and the Dark Side, tagged with the server it came from. Team and clan chat across servers are next (only your own teammates will see them).
Vehicle shop: 170+ vehicles

Karuza's whole lineup is in /vb (or /vehicle): cars, copters, trucks, karts, a flying broom, the Spookopter, a rocket chair... Your vehicle arrives as an item that may look like a box, or even a coffin. Place it, or use Spawn in My Vehicles.
The Kamikaze
A homemade rocket with a cockpit. It flies once. It can't hurt other players or bases, and Grimwood Mutual is still investigating.
Exploding cows
The CattlePult's cow now goes off like C4 when it lands. No refunds.
Special Delivery Special
A bolt-action rifle that sends a C4 from your inventory with every shot. 8 seconds between C4 shots.
Ageless livestock
/lm ageless keep stops an adult from dying of old age; /lm ageless keep herd does your whole herd, up to your limit. /lm young keep keeps calves small.
What's new, in game
Type /news (or /changelog) for this page right inside Rust, plus a THIS WEEK tab in /info. You'll get a heads-up when a new week is posted.

sections.name: Better
items: Smoother server
A week of tuning: the main server now runs at about 60 FPS where it used to sit in the 40s.
Shop messages you can see
Every vehicle shop action (bought, not enough scrap, recalled, picked up) now pops up as a banner on screen.

sections.name: Coming soon
items: Hall of Titles
Raider titles by difficulty (Doorknocker to Nightmare Raider) and the Banzai titles for Kamikaze pilots, with a page showing who holds what.
Raids that count at home
Raids finished on the Dark Side will pay RP and earn titles on Misfits.
Skywriting
Planes that leave smoke trails in the sky.
The Colony
An alien world. No air, low gravity, very funny ways to arrive. In the works; not this wipe.
